name: The Seven

scaling.scaled: Pike push-ups, 95/65 lb thrusters and deadlifts, banded pull-ups. Seven movements × seven rounds punishes poor transitions — station setup before the clock is half the score.
scaling.beginner: 4-5 rounds of 5 reps: elevated push-ups, light thrusters, sit-ups (for knees-to-elbows), light deadlifts, burpees, light swings, ring rows.

origin.summary: Honors seven CIA officers killed on December 30, 2009, when a suicide bomber attacked Forward Operating Base Chapman in Khost, Afghanistan. Seven rounds of seven reps of seven movements — the arithmetic is the memorial.

description: Seven rounds of seven reps each across seven different movements — handstand push-up, thruster, knees-to-elbows, deadlift, burpee, kettlebell swing, and pull-up.
source_notes: crossfit.com/heroes (official CrossFit Hero and Tribute Workouts page), retrieved 2026-07-08
